summary: Source-anchored research for GDDR7 Four-Channel Interleaving Architecture. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: Each 16-bit sub-channel commands its own bank cycle timing (tRC, tRP, tRCD), allowing concurrent row activations across independent bank groups. (high confidence)
A standard 256-bit GDDR7 interface provides 16 pseudo-independent 16-bit sub-channels across four 64-bit physical memory controllers. (high confidence)
